context: ADMINISTRATION For the short-term (five days or less) management of acute pain, the recommended dose of Tramadol HCl 37.5 mg/Acetaminophen 325 mg is 2 tablets every 4 to 6 hours as needed for pain relief, up to a maximum of 8 tablets per day.
